The required pre-push/fan-in evidence checkpoint for parallel agent development branches.

The atomic wasm-build swap behavior (temp directory + rename) that prevents a concurrent reader seeing a half-written artifact set.
The provider-neutral readiness script that discovers existing manifests and runs only local commands from a selected profile.
The deterministic local evidence entrypoint that runs the five-surface sweep.
A named scope of local checks (skeleton, python, security, cargo, all) defined by the readiness script.
The captured record of source revision, runtime versions, commands, artifacts, validation status, and gate state for a release.
